tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.notes: Student org wants 20 hoodies, size M, asking for a bulk discount.

board_drafts.body:
Hello Yale AI Club,

Thanks for asking about 20 navy hoodies in size M. Our current records show 8 in stock, so we are 12 short of the quantity requested.

The stored list price is $58 per hoodie, and the recorded unit cost is $22. The $22 figure is internal cost, not a customer price or discount offer. No discounted price has been approved or quoted, and this draft does not confirm an order or fulfillment.

We cannot yet confirm that additional units can be supplied. Bulldog Print Co is listed as an apparel reprint vendor with a stored 5-day lead time, but its ability to supply this specific hoodie is unconfirmed. Its $840 invoice is open; vendors cannot ship while they have an unpaid invoice. The checking balance recorded today is $3,400, but no purchase or payment is authorized or committed. Any payment requires human approval.

We therefore cannot promise availability or timing for the remaining 12 units. A suitable supplier and the funding/payment requirements would need to be confirmed before any commitment.

Best,
Campus Customs

Hello Tauhid,

A pre-fulfillment update on your size S Bulldog tee: for this assignment, the supplier quote is a user-authorized simulation—a simulated $8 quote from Bulldog Print Co for one CC-TEE-WHITE, size S, with a simulated confirmation that paid invoice 501 covers it. This was not fetched from the supplier; no supplier was contacted.

The recorded receipt is also a user-authorized simulation: the scenario assumes one size S tee was received. That is not a physical observation or independently verified shipment. The shop record currently lists one size S tee in inventory, but this draft does not represent a new physical stock check.

These simulated records do not confirm that your order has been fulfilled. We will provide a further update when the order's fulfillment status is confirmed.

Best,
Campus Customs

Hello Yale AI Club,

We’re unable to accept your request for 20 navy hoodies in size M. Our current inventory record shows 8 size M hoodies, so we cannot fill all 20. The recorded checking balance is $160. At the stored planning cost of $22 per additional hoodie, 12 more would require $264, which exceeds that balance. This cost is an internal planning figure, not a customer price. We have not obtained a supplier quote for the additional hoodies, so their availability and cost are unconfirmed.

Please note that the earlier $52-per-hoodie proposal is superseded. It was not an accepted order, and no order has been accepted or fulfilled. No delivery is scheduled or promised.

We’re sorry we can’t fulfill this request as proposed.

Best,
Campus Customs

discount_decisions.rationale: Boss proposal for the requested bulk hoodie price: $52 per unit, $6 below the stored $58 list price while remaining $30 above stored $22 unit cost. This is a proposed shop decision only; customer acceptance is not recorded or implied. Ticket cannot be fulfilled now because exact M-size stock is 8 of 20.

ticket_resolutions.rationale: Declined as directed. Exact size M stock is 8, insufficient for the request of 20. The 12-unit shortfall has a stored planning cost of $264 at $22 per unit, exceeding the $160 checking balance, and no supplier quote was obtained. The earlier $52 proposal is superseded and was not accepted. No purchase, payment, stock receipt, or fulfillment is authorized or implied.
